plugins.name: skilder
plugins.description: One place to maintain the skills, MCP servers and MCP Apps your team's agents use. Set them up once in a Skilder workspace, credentials included, and every connected agent gets each published change on its next task: no copies to sync, nothing to reinstall, and an audit trail of every call.
